description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
Bring the AI agent you already use into Spark.
This update makes it easier to connect compatible AI agents and use them with your inbox:
— Discover AI Agents in the sidebar. When Spark detects a compatible agent installed on your device, you can connect it directly from the new AI Agents entry point.
— Hand off an email thread. Open the current conversation in your preferred agent directly from the thread toolbar—without copying and pasting its contents.
— Start with ready-made Recipes. Use ten prepared prompts for tasks such as morning briefs, meeting preparation, follow-ups, drafting replies, finding deadlines, and planning inbox zero.
— Improved connection states, wording, and localization throughout the AI Agents experience.
Share your feedback at support@sparkmailapp.com.

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.30.8.140600/Spark.exe
